name: build
cmd: set -e; export E071_BASIS={outroot}/E071/basis E071_COMMUNITY={code}/research/E071/resident_community.csv; mkdir -p $E071_BASIS; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py bbs-points; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py spacetime-esk; ls -la $E071_BASIS/bbs_points $E071_BASIS/esk/spacetime
summarize: export E071_BASIS={outroot}/E071/basis; python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('$E071_BASIS/bbs_points/points_meta.json')); print({k: m[k] for k in ('n_rows','n_species','n_cells','rows_dropped_all_zero')})"
note: E071: BBS points + ESK basis for the 121-species resident community
